UI_StudioLink_profileTip: The profile active in PZ Mod Studio. Only its mods are listed.
UI_StudioLink_appClosedTip: PZ Mod Studio is not running. The list is the profile as it was when the app last wrote it; what you ask for here is done when the app opens.
UI_StudioLink_newModsTip:
{1} installed mod(s) are in no profile (subscribed outside PZ Mod Studio, for example). Click to add them to "{2}", switched off:

UI_StudioLink_noAnswer: PZ Mod Studio did not answer. Open it and the mods are added then.
UI_StudioLink_blocked: This save uses mods that are not in the profile "{1}":
UI_StudioLink_howTo: Switch to the profile you played it with in PZ Mod Studio, or add these mods to this profile.
UI_StudioLink_empty: This save's mod list is empty, while the profile "{1}" has {2} mods.
UI_StudioLink_emptyWhy: Loaded like this, the game would run it with no mods and drop every item that came from a mod. Yes gives it the profile's mods and loads it; No goes back.
UI_StudioLink_backupBeforeLoad: PZ Mod Studio is backing up "{1}" ({2}) before it loads: {3} A big save takes a moment.
UI_StudioLink_backupBeforeFix: PZ Mod Studio is backing up "{1}" ({2}) before its mod list is changed.
UI_StudioLink_whyChanged: its mods are not the ones of its last session.
UI_StudioLink_whyUpdated: {1} of its mods were updated since its last session.
UI_StudioLink_whyNever: PZ Mod Studio did not see its last session, so it cannot tell what changed.
UI_StudioLink_backupFailed: The save could not be backed up: {1}
UI_StudioLink_noAppLoad: PZ Mod Studio is closed, so "{1}" cannot be backed up before it loads. It would be, because {2}
UI_StudioLink_noAppFix: PZ Mod Studio is closed, so "{1}" cannot be backed up before its mod list is changed.
UI_StudioLink_changesTitle: What changed since its last session
UI_StudioLink_changesWhen: "{1}" was last played {2} ago. Since then:
UI_StudioLink_changesRemoved: Taken out of its mod list ({1})
UI_StudioLink_changesReordered: The load order of its mods changed.
UI_StudioLink_mapsOutWarning: Map mods were taken out: what they added to the world may be gone when it loads, and the game saves it that way.
UI_StudioLink_copyBody: PZ Mod Studio is copying "{1}" ({2}). The copy loads; the save itself stays as it is.
UI_StudioLink_copyNeedsApp: Playing on a copy needs PZ Mod Studio open: it makes the copy.
UI_StudioLink_copyFailed: The save could not be copied: {1}

UI_StudioLink_cardNoChanges: same mods as its last session
UI_StudioLink_cardChanges: since its last session: {1} updated, {2} added, {3} taken out
